scientific_integrity: The proof is intrinsic and uses the cited construction; the accompanying exact computations are consistency checks only. Published-source overlap was assessed with explicit residual risk; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complex base field; the bundle associated to the nondegenerate symplectic hyperplane of Koszul sections; only smooth rational normal cubics and set-theoretic jump locus. The underlying symplectic bundle has an earlier dual-twist description; the exact cubic-restriction invariant is the new theorem, not the construction.
title: The symplectic jumping divisor of twisted-cubic restrictions of a uniform rank-nine bundle
